name: docbin
description: General-purpose MS-DOC (.doc) parser and preview engine for the browser

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @docbin/core build && pnpm --filter @docbin/vue build && pnpm --filter @docbin/react build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @docbin/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @docbin/vue typecheck && pnpm --filter @docbin/react typecheck
